description: This file implements the HeartbeatProcedure class and related classes for handling heartbeat signals in a server context, including factory creation, heartbeat handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Main class managing heartbeat signals, including creation of handlers, and tracking sent pings.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling individual heartbeat events, such as ping sent, error, and lifecycle completion.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory for HeartbeatProcedure instances.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with specified ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatHandler::HeartbeatHandler
methods.description: Constructor for HeartbeatHandler, initializing with procedure, controlId, and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatHandler::~HeartbeatHandler
methods.description: Destructor that signals the finish of the heartbeat procedure.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Marks that a ping has been sent for a specific controlId.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the pingId associated with this handler.

methods.name: HeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Constructor initializing with ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatProcedure::~HeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Destructor that sends the final heartbeat status.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatHandler for a given controlId.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Records that a ping has been sent for a controlId.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Records the completion of a heartbeat, updating success status.
